title: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的策略路由优化方法，通过改变注意力路由引入随机探索，提高生成模型的训练效率。 Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的策略路由优化方法，通过改变注意力路由引入随机探索，提高生成模型的训练效率。强化学习可以使视觉生成器与超出其预训练目标的奖励信号对齐，但现有的得分函数方法通常通过扰动反向去噪轨迹来引入随机性，导致基于滚动展开的优化代价高昂。 我们转而探究能否在保留生成器原始采样器的同时，在生成器内部引入随机探索。 路由策略优化（RPO）通过将注意力路由转化为一个随机探索动作来回答这个问题。 在少数选定的去噪层级上，每个查询块保留其自身的块，并按生成器原生注意力质量的比例采样额外的键块，或保留稠密注意力。 采样得到的路由会扰动该转移的速度，并以稠密速度为中心的高斯似然通过得分函数目标对该扰动进行评分。 RPO 进一步采用受控的双滚动展开估计器：两次滚动展开共享相同的提示词、初始潜变量、路由去噪层级和稠密锚定层，仅在其采样的注意力路由上有所不同。 两者的奖励差异为被路由的转移提供了优势信号。 由于似然是对稠密速度本身求导，学习到的更新在移除路由后仍然有效。 在推理时，RPO 恢复稠密注意力并保留原始的确定性采样器。 在文本到图像和文本到视频生成上的实验表明，RPO 提升了生成质量，同时训练效率比 Flow-GRPO 风格的方法高出近 4 倍。 请访问我们的项目页面 https://velox-world.com/rpo 查看可视化结果。
